question: Should `listSessionEntries({ readOnly: true })` become a supported public plugin-SDK contract, with its non-create/non-register lifecycle semantics guaranteed for external plugins?
rationale: The branch regenerates the plugin-SDK baseline for a new public behavior; repository policy treats plugin API additions as compatibility-sensitive and requires maintainer-visible direction beyond a mechanical implementation review.

options.title: Approve the SDK contract after repairs
options.body: Keep the additive option, document its lifecycle guarantees, preserve the writable default, and add focused compatibility coverage after the two P1 defects are fixed.

options.title: Keep readonly access internal
